hook: Trump, Xi, Putin: one table, first time
reel_hook: Three superpowers, one table. What happened?

slides.title: Trump, Xi, Putin: one table
slides.image_prompt: Three empty ornate chairs around a round wooden table in an elegant Chinese villa hall, three teacups, soft evening light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Trump, Xi and Putin met together for the first time.
WHY IT MATTERS
After about 90 minutes, no major breakthroughs were announced.
FOR YOU
No deal yet, so nothing changes today. Their joint statement sets the agenda.
slides.body: Trump, Xi and Putin met together for the first time. After about 90 minutes, no major breakthroughs were announced. No deal yet, so nothing changes today. Their joint statement sets the agenda.

slides.title: A pledge for more oil
slides.image_prompt: Three oil barrels side by side on a dock at sunset, a pipeline stretching toward the horizon
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The three pledged more production and supply of oil products.
WHY IT MATTERS
The goal is to keep the world's energy flowing steadily.
FOR YOU
It's a pledge, not a price cut. Watch whether fuel supply actually grows.
slides.body: The three pledged more production and supply of oil products. The goal is to keep the world's energy flowing steadily. It's a pledge, not a price cut. Watch whether fuel supply actually grows.

slides.title: Talks to cut nuclear risks
slides.image_prompt: An old brass padlock resting on a cracked concrete slab beside a rusted chain, dramatic low light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
They backed talks on nuclear risks and weapons spreading.
WHY IT MATTERS
New START, the last US-Russia arms treaty, expired in February.
FOR YOU
Right now no treaty limits US and Russian arsenals. Talks could change that.
slides.body: They backed talks on nuclear risks and weapons spreading. New START, the last US-Russia arms treaty, expired in February. Right now no treaty limits US and Russian arsenals. Talks could change that.

slides.title: A warning to world courts
slides.image_prompt: A wooden gavel on a marble desk beside a tilted brass scale of justice, cool morning light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
They warned bodies like the ICC not to "abuse their jurisdiction."
WHY IT MATTERS
Their statement also calls for reform of the UN.
FOR YOU
Expect a bigger debate on how much power global courts and the UN hold.
slides.body: They warned bodies like the ICC not to "abuse their jurisdiction." Their statement also calls for reform of the UN. Expect a bigger debate on how much power global courts and the UN hold.

slides.title: The warhead gap
slides.image_prompt: Three rows of small metal chess pawns on a dark table: one short row and two very long rows, spotlight from above
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
China has more than 600 nuclear warheads.
WHY IT MATTERS
The US and Russia are each believed to have over 5,000.
FOR YOU
Now you know the numbers behind every headline about nuclear arms talks.
slides.body: China has more than 600 nuclear warheads. The US and Russia are each believed to have over 5,000. Now you know the numbers behind every headline about nuclear arms talks.

cta: Follow for the news, explained daily
caption:
🤝 Trump, Xi and Putin met at one table for the first time, in Shenzhen at APEC. No major breakthroughs.
🛢️ They pledged more oil products to keep energy flowing. A promise for now, so watch fuel supply.
☢️ They backed talks on nuclear risks. The last US-Russia arms treaty expired in February.
⚖️ They warned bodies like the ICC not to "abuse their jurisdiction" and called for UN reform.
🔢 Warheads: China 600+, the US and Russia over 5,000 each.

Can three rivals at one table actually cut nuclear risk? Tell us below 👇
